THE UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
ORDINANCE made by the University Grants Commission under Section 18 of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978.
Secretary, University Grants Commission.Colombo,12th June, 2025.
Ordinance
The Swamy Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies Ordinance, No. 01 of 2005 published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1396/4 of June 06, 2005 is hereby amended as follows:-

(1) in subparagraph (g) of paragraph 4 thereof by the substitution for the words “studios, theatres and other buildings” of the words “studios, theatres, a printing centre, an art gallery and other buildings”;
(2) by the repeal of subparagraph (iii) of paragraph 5 thereof and the substitution therefor of the following: -
“(iii) Department of Studies;”;

(8) by the repeal of paragraph 14 thereof and the substitution therefor of the following: -
“14. (1) There shall be Departments of Study in respect of the disciplines of-
(a) Carnatic Music; (b) Dance, Drama and Theatre Arts; (c) Visual and Technological Arts; and (d) Information Technology.

(2) Each Department of Study shall have a Head of Department who shall be a Senior Professor, Professor, Associate Professor or Senior Lecturer and shall be appointed by the Board upon the recommendation of the Director.
(3) The Head of a Department shall hold oﬃ ce for a period of three years reckoned from the date of his appointment and shall, unless removed from oﬃ ce, be eligible for reappointment.

(4) Where owing to leave of absence, illness, or other cause, the Head of a Department is temporarily unable to perform the duties of his oﬃ ce for a period not exceeding three months, the Board shall appoint a Professor, Associate Professor or Senior Lecturer to act in the post of Head of Department for such period. Where however a Head of a Department retires or resigns, or is for other reasons is unable to perform the duties of his oﬃ ce for a period exceeding three months, the post of Head of Department shall be deemed to be vacant, and a new Head of Department shall be appointed in accordance with subparagraph (2).”.
